about.story_title: A great riff always beats workplace wellness perks
about.story_p1: Det 7:e Gunget was born from a shared realization: life is too short for bad guitar tone and sterile pop tracks. We've played in countless bands over the decades, but when the four of us met in the rehearsal space, things clicked instantly on the very first 12-bar blues.
about.story_p2: Our music is rooted in smoky Chicago clubs and southern swamp rock, delivered with Swedish self-deprecation and humor. We take the music very seriously — but never ourselves.
about.photo_caption: The whole crew gathered ahead of the summer season

privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Cookies
privacy.intro: Det 7:e Gunget respects your personal privacy. We only collect the minimal data required to respond to booking requests, send occasional newsletters, and provide music playback on our site.
privacy.cookie_manager_desc: You can change your consent for third-party media embeds at any time below.

privacy.section1_p1: Det 7:e Gunget (musicians based in Ängelholm & Skåne, Sweden) is the data controller for personal data collected through this website.
privacy.section2_p1: When you submit a booking inquiry through our contact form, we process your submitted information exclusively to answer your request, discuss dates, stage requirements, and fulfill performance agreements.
privacy.section2_list_items: Name/organizer, email address, phone number (optional), event type, date, and message content.
privacy.section2_purpose: Respond to gig inquiries and organize performances.
privacy.section2_retention: Data is retained as long as active communication or booking planning is ongoing, and deleted thereafter unless required by Swedish accounting legislation.
privacy.section3_p1: If you subscribe to our newsletter, we collect your email address to send you tour dates, song releases, and band updates.
privacy.section3_purpose: Distributing band news and gig announcements.
privacy.section3_unsubscribe: You can unsubscribe at any time with a single click using the unsubscribe link in any email or by contacting us.
privacy.section4_p1: Our website uses a small number of essential cookies to store your preferences, as well as optional third-party integrations to play tracks and videos.

privacy.section5_p1: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have several rights regarding your personal information:
privacy.right_access_desc: You have the right to request a copy of the personal data we hold about you free of charge.

privacy.right_complaint_desc: If you believe your data is processed unlawfully, you may lodge a complaint with your supervisory authority (Integritetsskyddsmyndigheten IMY in Sweden).

epk.fact_lineup_val: 4 musicians (Lead vocals/harmonica, electric guitar, electric bass, drums)
epk.bio_short_title: Short Press Bio (for event pages, programs & flyers)
epk.bio_short_text: Det 7:e Gunget is a Swedish four-piece powerhouse delivering sweaty Chicago blues, heavy swamp rock, and melodic solos with a healthy dose of humor. Featuring glowing tube amps, fiery blues harmonica, and a rhythm section that rolls like a freight train, they bring an unpretentious full evening of original tunes and timeless blues classics.
epk.bio_long_text: Det 7:e Gunget was formed out of a shared passion for raw, authentic, and dynamic blues grooves that can never be faked or programmed. The band features four seasoned musicians who take the music – but never themselves – seriously. Their repertoire is an energetic mix of original compositions and heartfelt interpretations of giants such as Muddy Waters, B.B. King, and Stevie Ray Vaughan. No backing tracks, no primadonnas – just pure playing joy, warm tube tone, and a groove that gets the whole room rocking.
epk.download_photos_desc: Click download to retrieve print-quality original images (300 DPI). Free for use in promotional flyers, festival programs, articles, and reviews.

epk.logos_desc: High-res emblems and badges for poster printing and digital marketing.

epk.stage_plot_subtitle: Standard stage layout (Audience perspective / Front of House view):
epk.pos_janis_desc: Center front. Shure 55SH/SM58 vocal mic on boom stand, harp mic/DI for amp, Monitor Mix 1, 230V power outlet.
epk.pos_marcus_desc: Stage left (audience right). Guitar amp (mic'd), vocal mic (SM58 on boom stand), pedalboard, Monitor Mix 2, 230V power outlet.
epk.pos_bosse_desc: Stage right (audience left). Bass amp (balanced DI out), vocal mic (SM58 on boom stand), Monitor Mix 3, 230V power outlet.
epk.pos_jonas_desc: Center back. Drum kit on non-slip rug (min 2x2 m), full drum mic set (kick, snare, toms, OH), Monitor Mix 4 / headphones, 230V power outlet.
epk.channel_list_desc: 13 inputs. Standard patch list for front-of-house console:
epk.backline_band_brings_1: Complete backline: Electric guitar amp (Fender Tweed), bass amp (Ampeg), instruments, and pedalboards.
epk.backline_band_brings_2: Complete vintage Ludwig drum kit including cymbals and snare.
epk.backline_band_brings_3: Personal vocal and harmonica microphones (including the iconic Shure 55SH 'Elvis mic').
epk.backline_band_brings_4: For intimate venues/private parties: In-house compact PA and vocal sound system (upon agreement).
epk.backline_venue_provides_1: Front-of-house PA system adequately powered for the venue with clean headroom and even coverage.
epk.backline_venue_provides_2: 4 separate monitor lines (AUX 1–4) with stage wedges or balanced XLR outputs for IEMs.
epk.backline_venue_provides_3: Microphones, DI boxes, and XLR cabling according to the channel list above.
epk.backline_venue_provides_4: At least two independent 230V 10A/16A grounded power circuits on stage.
epk.backline_venue_provides_5: Stage area of at least approx. 4 x 3 meters with stable flooring and adequate clearance.
epk.hospitality_intro: Det 7:e Gunget is a no-drama, down-to-earth band without unreasonable diva demands. All we need to deliver an unforgettable night of blues is the following basics:
epk.hosp_food_desc: Warm meal for 4 people before or after soundcheck (home cooking, quality pizza, or hearty pub food is deeply appreciated!). Unlimited fresh brewed coffee (vital fuel for the band).
epk.hosp_drinks_desc: Mineral water (still/sparkling), soft drinks, and a few cold beers for relaxing after the show.
epk.hosp_room_desc: Lockable, heated room with seating for 4, mirror, clothes rack, and access to a restroom.
epk.hosp_arrival_desc: We normally arrive 2 hours prior to doors opening for load-in, setup, and approx. 30-40 minutes of soundcheck.
epk.print_footer_note: Det 7:e Gunget • Official Technical Rider • www.det7egunget.se • kontakt{'@'}det7egunget.se
